scope: Mock integration in real Chromium: controlled recognition, TTS and model; real MediaRecorder with fake device; isolated local database. Not real voice/model acceptance.
passed: single answer at question 1/7 is reviewed without creating a saved attempt; metrics stay collapsed
retry keeps question position, replaces transcript and clears obsolete coaching
failed feedback retains input; edited answer cannot receive a stale delayed result
discard removes unfinished draft and unshared takes, preserving an earlier saved recording
discard during recording stops tracks and cannot resurrect a draft after callbacks settle
seven-question review has its own group heading and separate per-sentence word reviews
exam mode has discard but does not reveal coaching, reference or retries mid-exam
full mock in practice mode pauses after an answer so it can be reviewed or retried
